incidents.name: GALA v2 dormant minter-role key compromise
incidents.notes: A dormant third-party address still holding the GALA v2 token's minter role was compromised and used to call mint() for 5,000,000,000 GALA; the token behaved exactly as written and its owner-controlled blocklist capped the realized loss.

sources.ref: onchain review: GALA v2 proxy 0xd1d2eb1b1e90b638588728b4130137d262c87cae created 2023-04-19 by 0xdae4249fa57610723b1f1b1c0379897aed4c9f26 (Gala deployer), single Upgraded event at creation; mint call from compromised minter EOA 0xec78b484a28a73f4f1cff23b9cd31aa12c1d9b4e to recipient 0xe2ca471124b124831e231fb835778840ad100f97. lossUsd is the ~$21.8m realized in ETH before the blocklist froze the recipient (rekt.news), not the ~$200m nominal mint; the proceeds were returned the next day.
